name: Conditional Prepaint Style Recompute

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

primaryTarget: gpui Interactivity prepaint and headed Test Suite WASM/WebGPU
hypothesisMarkdown: `Interactivity::prepaint` computes the same style twice for ordinary non-sticky elements. Reusing the first result unless a sticky-state refinement or synchronous sticky-state listener can change the result will remove one full style construction/refinement pass per ordinary prepaint while preserving dynamic sticky behavior.
measurementPlanMarkdown: Change only the redundant second prepaint style computation in `crates/gpux/crates/gpui/src/elements/div.rs`, retaining recomputation when a stuck style can apply or a sticky-state listener can synchronously change style inputs. Compare three independent headed WebGPU benchmark processes at DPR 1 and DPR 2 against experiment 68 medians. Require exact established rendering, layout, text, scroll, worker, and error invariants; focused/full gpux tests; all serialized WGPU tests; production and diagnostic checks; focused formatting; and warning-denied Clippy. Pass if both DPRs avoid material regression and profile/cadence evidence is consistent with removed repeated work.
expectedOutcomeMarkdown: Style refinement and allocation pressure should fall, with a modest throughput and/or paced-p95 improvement. Ordinary nodes must reuse the first prepaint style, while sticky-state callbacks and applicable stuck styles retain their existing recomputation path.

playwright: Three independent headed Chromium/WebGPU processes passed DPR 1 and DPR 2: 6/6 cadence cases, exact final offset -351402.6875, and zero terminal errors.
One additional profiled headed Chromium/WebGPU process passed both DPRs: 2/2 cases with CPU profiles and exact runtime invariants.
rayx: All 419 gpux unit tests and every gpux integration suite passed with rayx_diagnostics, including focused sticky callback and when_stuck behavior.
All 52 serialized gpui_wgpu tests passed with rayx_diagnostics.

Gpux production and diagnostics checks, warning-denied gpux Clippy, native Test Suite production and diagnostics checks, focused rustfmt, and diff checks passed; existing unrelated Test Suite warnings remain.
counters: Every headed case preserved 1,123 Taffy nodes, 229 measured leaves, 82 compute-layout calls, exact text-cache counters, nine renderer batches, 12 queue-buffer writes, one submission, shared memory, and the worker entry point.
The threaded WASM atomic prefix changed from 99,112 to 99,106 bytes.

reportMarkdown:
## Conditional Prepaint Style Recompute Finished

**Index:** 69
**Checkpoint:** `443d81d75faf3f9dca2c2fd056adafe83aca62b5`
**Result:** `87c84bb49ba024f2f8ca708101af4e7ceb64e770`
**Attempt Count:** 1

### Report

**Passed Status:** true. `Interactivity::prepaint` now retains the style computed before positioned-bounds resolution and recomputes only when an applicable stuck refinement or a sticky-state listener can change the post-publication result. Ordinary nodes avoid one complete style default-and-refine pass without cross-phase caching or new invalidation state.

Three independent headed WebGPU processes passed both DPRs. Versus experiment 68, median acknowledged throughput moved -0.61% at DPR 1 and +1.51% at DPR 2; paced p95 improved 0.95% and 0.62%. The small DPR 1 throughput movement is within process spread and is paired with lower p95. Fresh profiles reduced `compute_style_internal` self time 29.41%/10.63% at DPR 1/2.

All 419 gpux unit tests and integration suites, all 52 serialized WGPU tests, production and diagnostic checks, warning-denied gpux Clippy, focused formatting, six final headed cases, and two profiled headed cases passed. Exact renderer, layout, text, scroll, worker, and error invariants remained unchanged.

### Scope Lock

Only conditional reuse of the already-computed prepaint style and the narrow sticky-positioning guidance changed. No style cache, refinement-macro, Taffy, renderer, or adjacent lifecycle change was included.

### Decision

Accept the conditional recomputation. It removes a structurally redundant ordinary-node pass, preserves conservative recomputation for synchronous sticky callbacks and applicable stuck styles, lowers the targeted profile cost, and passes the no-material-regression cadence gate.
decisionMarkdown: Accept the conditional prepaint style recomputation. Preserve recomputation when a sticky-state listener exists or the resolved element is stuck with a `when_stuck(...)` refinement; reuse the first style for all other prepaint paths.
